Also find where a codex integration failure under `--integrations auto` causes ALL agent-sync (including claude/hermes) to be skipped ("Skipped agent-sync: codex integration failed under --integrations auto").

B) Skill sync digest self-mismatch: `genie install --integrations claude` reports "created 22", but immediately after, `genie doctor` reports "0/22 source skills current, 22 stale; council.js stale (LENS_ROOT unreadable)" and `genie update` reports "kept-modified 22, stamp skipped". Find: (1) where the per-skill `.genie-sync.json` digest is computed and what content it hashes (pre- or post-stamping/transformation?); (2) where doctor/update compute the comparison digest and why they'd disagree with a fresh sync; (3) what LENS_ROOT is, how it's resolved (stable ~/.genie/plugins/genie root vs CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT per CLAUDE.md), and why it could be "unreadable" right after a fresh install when ~/.genie/plugins/genie exists.

C) `genie uninstall --no-interactive` still shows the interactive "Are you sure?" (y/N) prompt instead of exiting 2. Find where the global --no-interactive flag is defined/consumed and why the uninstall confirmation ignores it.

Return a structured summary: root cause per defect, file:line, quoted code, and how localized a fix would be (one function? cross-cutting?).

DEFECT ANALYSIS — GENIE FRESH INSTALL ISSUES

## A) "Refusing repository-local codex CLI executable"

Root cause: The trusted-executable validator refuses executables under repository roots (including git worktrees). It computes forbiddenRoots from process.cwd() and all enclosing git repositories, then filters out roots that are contained in the user's home directory. The actual refusal logic (line 147) checks if the executable candidate is inside any forbidden root. When codex integration fails for any reason, install skips all agent-sync including Claude/hermes (line 367).

Where executable is refused:
- src/lib/trusted-executable.ts:147 — throw Error('Refusing repository-local ${name} executable: ${candidate}')
- src/lib/trusted-executable.ts:142 — forbiddenRoots computation: [...new Set([canonicalCwd, ...resolveEnclosingGitTrustRoots(canonicalCwd)])].filter((root) => !isSameOrContainedPath(root, canonicalHome))

When agent-sync is skipped:
- src/genie-commands/install.ts:353 — const codexFailed = results.some((result) => result.runtime === 'codex' && !result.ok);
- src/genie-commands/install.ts:367 — '  ! Skipped agent-sync: codex integration failed under --integrations auto...'

Fix scope: Localized to two functions:
1. validateTrustedExecutablePath() in trusted-executable.ts — refine git-root filtering
2. runPermittedPostDeliveryIntegrations() in install.ts — do not suppress Claude/hermes agent-sync when codex fails under --integrations auto

---

## B) Skill sync digest self-mismatch

Root cause: Doctor's councilStampState() function (line 1001) extracts LENS_ROOT from council.js using regex (line 1008). If the __GENIE_LENS_ROOT__ placeholder has not been stamped with the actual plugin path, the regex returns null and doctor reports stale (LENS_ROOT unreadable). This causes a mismatch with install's recorded digest because the install-time digest was computed over post-stamped files.

Where digest is checked:
- src/genie-commands/doctor.ts:1001 — function councilStampState(councilPath: string, pluginRoot: string): { stale: boolean; label: string }
- src/genie-commands/doctor.ts:1008 — const match = content.match(/const LENS_ROOT = '([^']*)'/);

If regex match fails, line 1011 returns: { stale: true, label: `stale (LENS_ROOT ${root ?? 'unreadable'})` }

Fix scope: Cross-cutting — three areas need coordination:
1. agent-sync.ts — ensure install-time digest matches doctor's recomputation method
2. doctor.ts:1008 — improve robustness when LENS_ROOT placeholder is not yet stamped
3. council-stamp.cjs — ensure stamping happens synchronously before digest is recorded

---

## C) --no-interactive flag ignored in uninstall

Root cause: The uninstall command prompts for confirmation (line 3579) without checking isInteractive(). The global flag is defined (line 49) and isInteractive() checks it (line 25), but uninstall never calls the check before prompting the user.

Where flag is defined and checked:
- src/genie.ts:49 — program.option('--no-interactive', 'Disable interactive prompts (exit 2 instead of prompting)');
- src/lib/interactivity.ts:25 — if (process.argv.includes('--no-interactive')) return false;

Where uninstall prompts without checking:
- src/genie-commands/uninstall.ts:33 — import { confirm } from '@inquirer/prompts';
- src/genie-commands/uninstall.ts:3579 — const proceed = await askConfirm({ message: 'Are you sure you want to uninstall Genie CLI?', default: false });

Fix scope: Localized to uninstall handler — add isInteractive() guard before line 3579. Must import isInteractive from src/lib/interactivity.ts and exit(2) if not interactive.
